benefits.title: Concrete results at every stage of growth.
benefits.intro: MarketSoft is not only about putting an offer online. It structures your commercial operations, simplifies the customer journey and gives you a foundation that can evolve with your business.

items.title: Centralize your commerce
items.text: Bring catalogues, services, sales, bookings, payments and operations into one environment instead of multiplying tools.

items.title: Save time every day
items.text: Automate confirmations, statuses, alerts, promotions and repetitive tasks so teams can focus on selling and serving customers.

items.title: Create a smoother journey
items.text: Give customers a simple path from discovery to purchase, booking or request, on mobile and desktop.

items.title: Sell products and services
items.text: Manage physical products, services, bookings or hybrid offers within the same platform.

items.title: Manage with useful data
items.text: Track revenue, orders, bookings, top-performing offers and key indicators through clear dashboards.

items.title: Evolve with your business
items.text: Add languages, countries, locations, providers, partners, modules or business rules over time without starting again.

items.title: Keep control of your data
items.text: Maintain a controlled architecture, structured access and an exploitable data foundation for long-term evolution.

items.title: Match access to your teams
items.text: Define roles and permissions so each employee, partner or administrator only sees the features they need.

items.title: Connect digital and physical
items.text: Combine online sales, pickup, delivery, appointments, branches, stores or on-site services according to your model.

items.title: Reduce operational errors
items.text: Centralized statuses, availability and information reduce duplicate entry, missed updates and inconsistencies between systems.

items.title: Prepare for growth
items.text: A modular foundation lets you start with what matters and strengthen the platform as volumes, teams and needs grow.

items.title: Connect your ecosystem
items.text: Integrate payments, delivery, marketing, CRM or business tools through APIs when your organization needs more.

compare.title: Choose in under a minute.
compare.intro: Compare essential features, management depth, multi-partner capabilities, integrations and customization to choose the foundation that best fits your business.

faq.title: Answers before you start.
faq.intro: Essential answers about deployment, payments, hosting, maintenance and how MarketSoft can evolve.

items.q: How long does it take to launch the platform?
items.a: The Essential offer is planned around one week, the Advanced offer around ten days, and the marketplace between two and four weeks. Custom timing depends on the scope.
Yes. A payment method can be integrated depending on the package, country and selected provider.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. MarketSoft is designed to be deployed under your company identity and domain.
Yes. The architecture is designed to add capabilities, integrations, sellers, languages or points of sale progressively.
The platform can be hosted in the environment defined with you. The exact terms are specified in the offer and maintenance agreement.
The maintenance scope is defined according to the selected package and can cover monitoring, updates, backups, security and support.

items.q: Can I migrate my existing offers?
items.a: Yes. Product, service or appointment data migration can be planned depending on the format and quality of the source data.
Ownership, hosting and usage terms are defined contractually according to the selected project and support model.

packages.name: Commerce Essential
packages.target: A professional commerce platform ready to sell, designed for a business offering its own products, services or appointments through a simple journey, clear administration and the essential selling and payment capabilities.

modules.title: Public website
items: Home, company presentation, catalog and product pages
Contact, social links and essential legal pages

modules.title: Sales
items: Online payment, cash on delivery or bank transfer as needed

outcomes: Launch a professional mobile-ready online store quickly.
Present a structured catalog with product pages and multiple images.
Receive, review and process orders from a simple administration area.
Offer the payment and delivery methods defined for your business.
Manage products and core day-to-day operations yourself.

packages.name: Commerce Advanced
packages.target: An advanced commerce platform for businesses that regularly sell products or services and need stronger management of customers, offers, availability, promotions, fulfillment and performance from one system.

modules.title: Customers & conversion
items: Customer accounts, addresses, favorites and invoices

modules.title: Inventory & delivery
items: Inventory by variant and movement history

outcomes: Manage a rich catalog with sizes, colors, variants and detailed stock.
Give customers their own space with history, invoices and favorites.
Create promotions, discount codes and advanced commercial rules.
Organize multiple delivery methods and zones with shipment tracking.
Monitor sales through actionable statistics and dashboards.

packages.name: Multi-partner marketplace
packages.target: A complete marketplace designed to bring multiple sellers, service providers, brands, suppliers or partners together on one platform. Each partner gets a dedicated space while the platform owner keeps central control over offers, sales, rules and overall performance.

modules.title: Sellers
items: Products, prices, inventory and orders limited to each seller

outcomes: Let multiple sellers manage their products, stock and orders separately.
Control seller onboarding and approve products before publication.
Automatically split an order between the relevant sellers.
Manage returns, disputes, reviews, commissions and seller performance.
Scale the marketplace to more sellers, categories and sales volume.

packages.name: Custom platform
packages.target: A tailored platform built from the MarketSoft foundation when your business model requires specific business features, external integrations, custom workflows or an experience beyond the three standard offers.

modules.title: Foundation
items: Choose a MarketSoft package as the foundation

outcomes: Start from a proven MarketSoft foundation instead of building everything from scratch.
Adapt workflows and business rules to your organization.
Add modules or features not included in the standard packages.
Connect MarketSoft to external tools through APIs when needed.
Expand the solution progressively according to business priorities.

pricing.title: Cost structure
pricing.intro: The cost is split between setting up your platform and the ongoing services required to keep it reliable, secure and usable over time.
pricing.firstYearDescription: The first year includes the package implementation price plus an initial maintenance & support fee.
pricing.annualDescription: From the second year onward, the initial platform installation and setup fees are not charged again. The annual amount covers only maintenance and support for the package.
pricing.maintenanceIntro: Maintenance is intended to keep the platform stable, secure and compatible with its technical environment.

maintenanceItems.title: Corrective maintenance
maintenanceItems.text: Fixes for defects and malfunctions covered by the scope of the selected package.

maintenanceItems.title: Preventive maintenance
maintenanceItems.text: Regular checks, monitoring of sensitive areas and actions intended to reduce the risk of incidents.

maintenanceItems.title: Technical updates
maintenanceItems.text: Dependency updates, security patches and adaptations required to maintain technical compatibility.

maintenanceItems.title: Technical monitoring
maintenanceItems.text: Checks of core operation and performance, plus support during maintenance operations.

pricing.supportIntro: Support helps your teams use MarketSoft correctly and resolve difficulties related to the features included in the package.

supportItems.title: User assistance
supportItems.text: Help using included features and handling common functional questions.

supportItems.title: User training
supportItems.text: Onboarding for key users at launch and targeted refresher sessions when needed.

supportItems.title: User guides
supportItems.text: Guides and instructions for the platform’s main day-to-day operations.

supportItems.title: Administrator support
supportItems.text: Assistance with administration, routine settings and day-to-day operation of the package.

pricing.exclusions: New features, external integrations, major UX/UI redesigns or changes outside the package scope are not included in annual maintenance and are quoted separately.
